box.highlights: East Islip 22, Bellport 10: Jake Simmons ran for 225 yards and 2 TDs to lead host East Islip in Suffolk II. Evan Gordon had three tackles for loss and Andrew Arena caught a touchdown. PJ Gannon ended Bellport's last drive with an interception.
East Islip defeats Commack in Suffolk II.

East Islip 61, Smithtown East 21: Jake Simmons ran for 231 yards, three touchdowns and had a sack to lead host East Islip (3-0) in Suffolk II. Will Gonzalez ran for 76 yards and a score and Andrew Arena had 59 rushing yards and a TD. Evan Gordon had a 27-yard fumble return TD and Parker Redding had a 35-yard interception return score. Antonio Marrone threw two touchdown passes for Smithtown East (1-2)
Jake Simmons had 23 carries for 130 yards and two TDs for East Islip (4-0) in Suffolk II.

East Islip 37, North Babylon 35: AJ Ierardi led East Islip to a 37-35 road win over North Babylon, completing six of 10 passing attempts for 201 yards and three touchdowns along with a 1-yard TD run Saturday in Suffolk II. He also converted two 2-point attempts on the ground. Jake Simmons ran 15 times for 87 yards and a TD. Niko Myers caught three passes for 104 yards and a TD, and Eddie Simonetti had two receptions for 85 yards and two scores for East Islip (5-0). Rushers Dominic Prestano (19-105-2), TJ Shaw (10-108-2), Jovan Greenhill (7-95-1) and Jack Miller (7-80) led a rushing attack for North Babylon (2-3) that totaled over 400 yards.
Half Hollow Hills East 28, East Islip 7: Half Hollow Hills East defeats East Islip in Suffolk II.

East Islip 28, Connetquot 7: Niko Meyers had nine carries for 173 yards and two touchdowns and Jake Simmons ran 23 times for 151 yards and two TDs to lead host East Islip (6-1) in Suffolk II. Evan Gordon and Jovan Bonilla each had a sack. Nick Mastriano caught an 11-yard TD pass from Vincent Feraca for Connetquot (2-5).

East Islip 31, Northport 21: Jake Simmons rushed for 242 on 35 carries and 3TDs to lead visiting East Islip (7-1) in Suffolk II. Niko Meyers rushed for 37 yards on 4 carries and 1 TD and Chris Coreas had an 18-yard FG. Simon Blissett completed 13 of 24 passes for 287 yards and 2 TDs for Northport (7-1).

East Islip 38, Connetquot 0: Jake Simmons had 25 carries for 188 yards and four touchdowns to lead host No. 1 East Islip over No. 8 Connetquot in the Suffolk II quarterfinals. Mikey Tramaglini had an interception and Dylan Bayer recovered a fumble forced by Andrew Arena. AJ Ierardi added a 2-yard TD run and Chris Coreas made a 30-yard field goal and all five of his PATs. East Islip (8-1) will host a semifinal at 4 p.m. on Friday. Connetquot finished 3-6.

No. 1 East Islip defeats No. 4 Northport in the Suffolk Division IV semifinals. East Islip (9-1) will face the winner of No. 2 Half Hollow Hills East/No. 3 Huntington in the final at 6 p.m. on Saturday, Nov. 22 at Stony Brook University.

East Islip 24, Half Hollow Hills East 17: No. 1 East Islip defeated No. 2 Half Hollow Hills East (8-3) in the Suffolk Division II championship game at Stony Brook University. This is the tenth Suffolk title for East Islip and its third title in the last five years. Jake Simmons had 32 carries for 244 yards and 3 touchdowns for East Islip. East Islip (10-1) will face Nassau's Garden City in the Long Island Class II championship game Saturday at Stony Brook at noon.
Garden City (12-0) defeats East Islip for the Long Island Class II title. It's Garden City's fifth straight LI title. The Trojans extended the longest active winning streak in the nation to 66 games.
